sources.title: 2026 Mount Emei Travel Guide: Temples, Trails & Tips
sources.content:
Mount Emei, located in Sichuan Province, is one of China's most sacred and spectacular mountains. Recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for both its cultural and natural significance since 1996, and towering at an altitude of 3,079 meters, the Golden Summit of Mount Emei is the highest Buddhist site in the world.

Best Time to Visit: The best two periods are April to June and September to November when the weather is most comfortable. If you travel Mount Emei only once, don't miss the winter (December-February) when Mount Emei takes on its most stunning scenery, with the change from green at the bottom to white in high altitude.

Getting There: You can take a high speed train from Chengdu East Railway Station or Chengdu South Railway Station to Emeishan Railway Station within 1.5 hours. During peak season, online booking is strongly recommended as tickets often sell out.

Must-See Highlights:
- Golden Summit: Mount Emei is globally renowned for its Golden Summit Buddha Light, sunrises above a sea of clouds, wild monkey colonies, and vast blossoming dove tree forests—known as its Four Wonders.
- Temples: There were more than 30 temples in the whole mountain in ancient times and 28 of them are well-preserved.

Practical Tips:
- Packing: Pack light and prepare a pair of comfortable hiking shoes. Hiking sticks will also be helpful.
- Cable Cars: Cable cars save time and energy, especially helpful in winter or for older travelers.
- Monkeys: Long sleeves are recommended to prevent allergic reactions to monkey fur.
- Accommodation: There are many homestays and hotels near Baoguo Temple at the foot of the mountain, accommodations near Qingyin Pavilion and Wannian Temple halfway up, and a hotel on the Golden Summit for those wanting to watch the sunrise.

sources.title: How to visit Mount Emei and hike to the top: our complete guide!
sources.content:
Mount Emei is a sacred Buddhist mountain in Sichuan Province, China, standing at 3,099 meters with the accessible summit (Golden Peak/Jinding) at 3,079 meters. The site features approximately 30 temples, lush vegetation, waterfalls, and around 60,000 steps total.

Best Visiting Times: Spring (March-May) and autumn (September-November) offer mild temperatures and fewer crowds. Winter provides snow scenery but potential closures. Avoid July-August and early October (Golden Week).

Entry Fee: 160 yuan high season (Jan 16-Dec 14), 110 yuan low season (Dec 15-Jan 15). Tickets valid 4 days.

Transportation:
From Chengdu: High-speed train (1 hour, ~110 yuan) is recommended over regular train (2 hours, 76 yuan) or bus (3 hours).
To Starting Point: From Emeishan station, take bus lines 5A or 12 to Baoguo village (40 minutes).

Hiking Options:
Full Hike: 48 km over 2-3 days with 5,315m elevation gain. The left flank trail features waterfalls and scenic temple areas away from tourists.
Cable Car/Bus Route: Total cost approximately 370 yuan ($45). Bus schedules: 6 a.m. to 6 p.m. high season, 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. low season.
Mixed Options: Combine hiking with cable car/bus at various points (Wannian, Wuxiangang, Leidongping).

Temple Accommodations: Sleeping in temples costs 40-50 yuan per person. Notable temples include Xianfeng Temple (50 yuan), Chu Monastery (40 yuan), Xixiangchi Temple, Taiziping Temple (near summit).

Practical Tips:
Water & Supplies: Carry 3+ liters and snacks; vendors inflate prices. Filtering bottles recommended.
Monkeys: Concentrated near Qingyin Pavilion bus stop where they aggressively steal items. Use hiking sticks or bamboo to deter. Keep everything well inside your backpack (glasses, phone, camera, food).
Clothing: Prepare multiple layers for temperature variations across 2,500m elevation gain.
Gear: Leave large backpacks at accommodation; carry day packs only.

What to See: Golden statue of Puxian (10-faced bodhisattva) at summit. Numerous temples with Buddhist atmosphere. Waterfalls and natural springs. Free-roaming monkeys in natural habitat. Carved rock faces and sculptures.

Nearby Attractions:
Leshan Giant Buddha: 15 minutes by train (64 yuan). The 70-meter Buddha carved into cliffside from the 8th century. Entry: 80 yuan, boat tour: 70 yuan additional.
Chengdu: 160 km away, features giant panda research center and People's Park.

Personal Experience: The authors completed the hike in two days via the left slope, descending the right side. Their recommendation: Take your time climbing via the left flank (in 3 days) and then invest 50 yuan to come down by bus.

sources.title: Mount Emei Tickets, Hours & How to Visit
sources.content:
Entry to Emeishan National Park costs 160 yuan per person in high season (January 16 to December 14) and 110 yuan in low season (December 15 to January 15). The ticket remains valid for 4 days.

Opening Hours: 06:00-18:00 off-peak season (December 15th to January 15th) and 07:00-18:00 peak season (January 16th to December 14th).

Getting There: Most people will be coming from Chengdu, and the high-speed train only takes about an hour and costs around 65 RMB. Buses leave from the tourist bus station whenever they're full between 7:20AM and 7:20PM, and you'll need to take a taxi to Baoguo village to reach the mountain.

Visiting Options: You can spend one day to visit the highlighting part (Leidongping to Golden Summit), or 2 days to hike from Wannian Temple to Golden Summit, or 3 days to have an in-depth hiking from Qingyin Pavilion to Golden Summit.

Additional Costs: For entry, buses and the cable car, you need a total of 370 yuan. Cable cars: Wannian Cableway (up ¥65, down ¥45) and Jinding Cableway/Golden Summit (up ¥65, down ¥55).

Best Time to Visit: Spring and autumn are ideal, particularly March to May and September to November.

sources.title: 峨眉山 - 百度百科
sources.content:
峨眉山属邛崃山脉支脉，地处中国四川盆地的西南边缘，介于北纬29°16′—29°43′，东经103°10′—103°37′之间。山体南北延伸105千米，主峰万佛顶海拔3099米。

地质与地貌：该山区地层出露完整，地质构造复杂，包含褶皱和断层两大类。地貌特征包括构造地貌、流水地貌、岩溶地貌和冰川地貌等多种类型。

气候与水文：峨眉山位于中亚热带季风气候区域，整个山区云雾多，日照少，雨量充沛。海拔2000米以上地区约半年时间被冰雪覆盖。山区有天然河流5条，属大渡河、青衣江水系。

生物资源：植物方面，峨眉山拥有3200种以上高等植物，约占中国植物物种总数的十分之一。动物资源包括2300多种，其中兽类51种、鸟类256种，包括小熊猫、林麝等珍稀物种。

文化与景观：作为普贤菩萨道场，峨眉山融合佛教、道教、武术文化。1996年被联合国教科文组织列入世界文化遗产名录。金顶的48米普贤金像是山的标志景观。景区以云海、日出、佛光、圣灯四大奇观闻名于世，景区现存寺庙30多处。

特产：主要产物包括峨眉雪芽茶、川贝母、朱砂莲、苦笋及白蜡等。

最新荣誉：2024年9月入选首批14座世界旅游名山名单；2026年1月起全山寺院向游客永久免费开放。

垂直落差2600米，具有世界上最典型、保存最完好的亚热带原始植被景观，现有植物5000多种、野生动物2300多种，素有植物王国、动物乐园和地质博物馆之美誉。

sources.title: 2026四川峨眉山旅游攻略大全
sources.content:
峨眉山门票分为旺季和淡季，旺季（1月16日至12月14日）160元/人，淡季（12月15日至次年1月15日）110元/人。

景区开放时间为6:00至18:30，不同季节及景区内部景点开放时间略有调整。

峨眉山位于四川省乐山市峨眉山市，是中国四大佛教名山之一，登顶可观云海、日出、佛光、圣灯、金殿、金佛六大奇观。

交通方式：游客可以自驾从峨眉山市驾车到停车场，需行驶2小时以上约100公里，或通过公共交通先到峨眉山市，然后乘坐大巴车到景区停车场。

景区实行分时、预约、限量措施，请游客合理安排行程，及时预订景区门票和观光车票，避免因门票或车票售罄，无法进入景区。
